body: #outlook a { padding:0; } body { margin:0;padding:0;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;-ms-text-size-adjust:100%; } table, td { border-collapse:collapse;mso-table-lspace:0pt;mso-table-rspace:0pt; } img { border:0;height:auto;line-height:100%; outline:none;text-decoration:none;-ms-interpolation-mode:bicubic; } p { display:block;margin:13px 0; } 96 .mj-outlook-group-fix { width:100% !important; } @import url(https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Arvo); @import url(https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Lato); @import url(https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Lora); @import url(https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Merriweather); @import url(https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Merriweather+Sans); @import url(https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noticia+Text); @import url(https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Open+Sans); @import url(https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display); @import url(https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto); @import url(https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Source+Sans+Pro); @media only screen and (max-width:600px){ .mj-column-per-100-0 { width:unset !important; max-width:unset; display:block !important; }} .emphasis { color:#a33600;font-weight:700; } .emphasis-2 { color:#537824;font-weight:700; } .emphasis-3 { color:#005cb9;font-weight:700; } Hi Ervin, Thank you for the time and effort you put into your application for the position of Machine Learning Engineer - Evisort at Workday. After careful consideration, the hiring team has decided to move forward with other candidates. We appreciate every candidate who applies to Workday. While this opportunity didnt result in an offer, we encourage you to explore future roles with us. To stay updated on new opportunities, please visit our workday.com/careers page page or stay up to date on our socials. Wishing you all the best in your job search. Warm regards, Workday Talent Acquisition This email was intended for ervsml@gmail.com Workday, Inc • 6110 Stoneridge Mall Road, Pleasanton, CA 94588
